m1.text: He asked me to lock him in. He said, don't let me collect.

q1.text: So he locked himself away. Like he did with the sick tenants.

d1.text: And the prints? He went for the stairs?

m2.text: He wanted to warn the tenants. He only made it to the first step.

q2.text: Every knock is a dinner bell. They're coming to the glass.

d2.text: I dodged his rent for six months. I know that knock.

d3.text: You knock back... and he waits.

end.text: Part nine. Where did the driver go?
